fullPassage: People may not think critically for a variety of reasons, such as laziness and inability, but fear is a big one. Why is that? People don't want to think not just because it's hard, but also because they're afraid it will make them question their long-held beliefs. Your students most likely do want to think about things that can be very controversial, like politics, ethics, and philosophy. But probe even deeper. Once we start thinking deeply, long-held assumptions are challenged. Thought makes us worry that we'll lose our balance and have to look at the world in a different way. We worry about thinking because we care about what we and other people think. Even the most far-fetched ideas have an effect on the world. Non-Euclidean geometry and symbolic logic are about as abstract as thinking can get, but you can't understand Einsteinian gravity without the first and run computers without the second. Thinking is important to us, to others, and to the world we live in. This is one reason why we are so afraid of it: it shakes us to the core.

Your students most likely do want to think about things that can be very controversial, like politics, ethics, and philosophy. But probe even deeper. Once we start thinking deeply, long-held assumptions are challenged. Thought makes us worry that we'll lose our __________ and have to look at the world in a different way. We worry about thinking because we care about what we and other people think. Even the most far-fetched ideas have an effect on the world. Non-Euclidean geometry and symbolic logic are about as abstract as thinking can get, but you can't understand Einsteinian gravity without the first and run computers without the second. Thinking is important to us, to others, and to the world we live in. This is one reason why we are so afraid of it: it shakes us to the core.

det.ref: [원문] we'll lose our balance and have to look at the world in a different way

③ curiosity ❌ — 호기심, 원문과 불일치
④ balance ✅ — 균형, 원문 일치
det.tip: lose one's balance = 균형을 잃다. 뒤의 'look at the world in a different way'와 연결.

det.ref: [원문] look at the world in a different way
det.correct: ③ familiar(익숙한) → different(다른): 사고가 세상을 '다른' 방식으로 보게 만든다는 맥락.
wrongs: ① fear ✅ — 두려움, 원문 일치
② long-held ✅ — 오래 지녀온, 원문 일치
③ familiar ❌ → different — 반의어로 교체
④ far-fetched ✅ — 허황된, 원문 일치
det.tip: different(다른) ↔ familiar(익숙한). 사고는 세상을 '다른' 방식으로 보게 만든다.

det.correct: (d) where we live in → we live in (또는 in which we live): where와 in이 중복. where = in which이므로 in을 빼거나 관계대명사로 교체.
